objective.text: Page-check the 17 ProQuest replicas (Peiresc harvest, 2026-11-24) whose passing would move decided orders into the claim-ready pool, under D-20261106-photius-p4; measure reader and adjudicator cost and pass rate so Bentham can rank the wider replica set.

premortem.failure: Readers pass replicas on the regex pre-read without reading the page (rubber-stamping)
premortem.guard: PROMPT.md forbids passing on auto_verdict; Opus adjudicates every fail, every unsure and a seeded 5% sample of passes, and disagreement on the sample is reported

premortem.failure: A file holds the neighbouring order or a cover slate and is credited to the wrong number
premortem.guard: pass requires the expected number visible or, with no number, date within a day plus signature block plus matching subject; the Opus sample checks pages, not the reader's text

premortem.failure: Image-heavy packets blow the context and cost (740 orders have no machine number or date hit)
premortem.guard: renders are 110 dpi grayscale, first/second/last page only; context_kill_tokens 120k; stage 0 measures tokens per packet before any wider run

premortem.failure: Post-1937 orders in the harvest fall outside the signature-word list and get unsure
premortem.guard: unsure is an allowed answer and goes to Opus; the probe packet is the lowest numbers, the wider stages report unsure rate by era

acknowledged_findings.F-20261110-mommsen-unranked-pools: Only orders in the named Bentham action acquire.ARCHIVAL_REPLICA_FOUND_NEEDS_PAGE_CHECK, drawn from extract.py targets; stage 0 is one lane and 30 orders; an unranked refusal stops the wave.
acknowledged_findings.F-20261107-haloander-undecided-probe: This wave assigns no status and runs no overlay route; it only page-checks replicas. Undecided orders gain a checked text, not a status, and the report says so.
acknowledged_findings.F-20261028-4: Packets are built after Pinakes regenerated on this branch (runs 45547393448 and 45550428437) and the tracker re-ran (45551893827), as the lesson asks.
acknowledged_findings.F-20261018-7: Every replica's sha256 and length were verified at harvest (2,097 of 2,097) and Pinakes rehashed them; renders are made from the committed bytes, so host success is measured, not forecast.

review.basis: Owner in chat 2026-11-25 00:20 ET: 'i pre approve that plan keep going'; 00:3x ET chose 'Fix Bentham, then follow it' (Kean decision D-20261125-peiresc-page-check).
